subject: extractive summarizer
source_sentence: MEAD is a centroid-based extractive summarizer which selects the most important sentences from a sequence of sentences based on a linear combination of three parameters: the sentence length, the centroid score and the position score.
title: SUMT: A Framework of Summarization and MT

subject: reranker
source_sentence: MEAD also employs a cosine reranker to eliminate redundant sentences.

subject: training

title: SUMT: A Framework of Summarization and MT

subject: Moses
source_sentence: The baseline MT system is the open-source MOSES phrase-based decoder trained on a standard English-Arabic parallel corpus.
title: SUMT: A Framework of Summarization and MT

subject: Tokenization
